texts.label: Why Uniswap Labs\?
texts.text: I am drawn to Uniswap Labs because of its pivotal role in decentralizing finance and its engineering-first culture that prioritizes open-source innovation and scalability. With my background scaling high-throughput transaction platforms at Bank of America and BlackRock, I am eager to apply my expertise in distributed systems, Python, and Go to build resilient, permissionless infrastructure that serves millions of users globally.

texts.label: Why do you want to work at EvenUp?
texts.text: I am drawn to EvenUp's mission to simplify the financial settlement process, which aligns perfectly with my background in scaling high-throughput transaction systems at Bank of America and BlackRock. My experience in building distributed platforms that handle millions of requests daily, combined with my proficiency in Python and Go, positions me to immediately contribute to your platform foundation while leveraging AI tools to accelerate development cycles.

texts.label: Based on the job description and your background, tell us why
texts.text: As a Senior Backend Software Engineer with 7 years of experience in fintech, I have successfully scaled real-time transaction platforms at Bank of America to handle millions of requests daily with a focus on latency and reliability. My background at BlackRock managing quantitative data systems, combined with my proficiency in Python, Go, and distributed systems, aligns perfectly with Posh's need for a Personalization Engineer who can build robust, scalable infrastructure. I am eager to apply my deep experience in high-throughput data processing and my proactive use of AI tools to drive personalized user experiences at Posh.
